name: Dual Enrollment (CCAP) at Diablo Valley College
city: Pleasant Hill, CA (also the San Ramon campus)
what_you_do: Take real college classes for free while you are still in high school. Some classes are at DVC campuses, and some are online. You earn college credit.
who_can_apply: High school students in a partner school district: Acalanes, Martinez (Alhambra High School), Mt. Diablo, or San Ramon Valley. Clayton Valley Charter High School also takes part. Each program has its own steps, so talk to your counselor.
pay_detail: Free. You pay no tuition, textbook or enrollment fees.
deadline_text: Each program sets its own dates. For CollegeConnect, the page says current 10th graders are encouraged to apply in February. Ask your counselor about the other programs.
how_to_apply: Talk to your high school counselor first. Then follow the steps for your school district on the DVC page. Questions go to the Early College Credit office at DVC.
notes: College Now is a middle-college program for Mt. Diablo 11th and 12th graders. Classes are at the DVC Pleasant Hill campus. CollegeConnect lets students earn up to 30 college units before they graduate. Diamante Scholars is a separate program for Mt. Diablo seniors. The page lists the Early College Credit email as EarlyCollegeCredit@dvc.edu.
